skills.name: Bite 'em, Kupa!
skills.description:
Popol throws a spear at the target enemy, dealing 80<font color='#D58E1F'>( +100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> while simultaneously commanding Kupa to lunge at the target, dealing an additional 100<font color='#D58E1F'>( +75% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font>. Kupa will continue to attack the target for 3s.
<font color='#404495'>(Alpha Wolf Form)</font>: Kupa stuns the enemy for 1s and bites them 3 times in quick succession.
skills.tips: Popol throws a spear at the target for Physical Damage and orders Kupa to bite them, dealing Physical Damage.

skills.name: Kupa, Help!
skills.description:
Popol summons Kupa back to his side, gaining a 240<font color='#D58E1F'>( +200% Extra Physical Attack)</font> shield while dealing 240<font color='#D58E1F'>( +50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 35% for 0.5s. Kupa will then assist Popol to attack nearby enemies for 3s.
<font color='#404495'>(Alpha Wolf Form)</font>: Kupa darts back to Popol, knocking nearby enemies airborne for 0.2s. The shield and damage are increased to 125%.
skills.tips: Popol summons Kupa to protect him, gaining a Shield, dealing Physical Damage to the nearby enemies and slowing them.

skills.name: Popol's Surprise
skills.description:
Popol sets a trap at the target location that will detonate after a short delay once triggered, dealing 70<font color='#27C0C7'>( +20% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to the enemy that steps on it, immobilizing them for 1s, and creating a frost zone for 4s. Enemies in the frost zone will have their Movement Speed reduced by 20%.
Popol gains a trap charge every 22s (up to 3). Up to 3 traps can exist at the same time on the battlefield, each lasting up to 60s.
skills.tips: Popol and Kupa become enraged, gaining extra attack speed and movement speed. At the same time, Kupa will enter “Alpha Wolf Form”, restoring all HP and boosting the power of their 1st and 2nd skill.

skills.name: We Are Friends
skills.description:
Kupa recovers 10% Max HP per second after not taking damage for 5s. When Kupa is killed, Popol can <font color='#404495'>(Pray)</font> for 3s to bring Kupa back to the battlefield. Cooldown: 30s.
Every 3 consecutive attacks from Kupa will enhance Popol's next Basic Attack to deal <font color='#D58E1F'>( +220% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font>. Kupa has 2500 <font color='#D58E1F'>( +1200% Total Physical Attack)</font> Max HP and inherits 100% of Popol's other attributes and passive equipment effects (excluding Jungling and Roaming equipment effects).
Kupa deals an additional <%Num10> damage against Creeps.
skills.tips: Nothing can separate Popol and Kupa, not even desperate battles. When Kupa escapes from combat, he will constantly regenerate HP under the good care of Popol. And even when Kupa has fallen on the battlefield, Popol's prayers can always bring him back. Kupa inherits the traits of Popol’s equipment items. And every 4 attacks performed by Kupa boosts the damage of Popol’s next basic attack.

items.name: Demon Hunter Sword
items.des: Unique Passive - Devour: Basic Attacks deal 8% of the target's current HP as extra Physical Damage (capped at 60 against minions).

items.name: Endless Battle
items.des: Unique Passive - Divine Justice: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3s deals 60% Physical Attack as extra True Damage (1.5s cooldown).

items.name: Windtalker
items.des: Unique Passive - Typhoon: Every 5-2s (reduced by 0.2s for each Basic Attack), the next Basic Attack will hit up to 3 enemy units for 150-362 Magic Damage. (This attack can Crit and the damage increases to 200% against Minions.)

items.name: Immortality
items.des: Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).

items.name: Blade of Despair
items.des: Unique Passive - Despair: Dealing damage to non-Minion enemies below 50% HP increases Physical Attack by 25% for 2s (takes effect before the damage is dealt).

synergy.name: Layla
synergy.tips: Combines high utility, excellent lane pressure, and perfect teamfight synergy with Layla.

counters.name: Gatotkaca
counters.tips: Excels against Gatotkaca in early game lane trades and isolates them effectively in teamfights.

countered_by.name: Aamon
countered_by.tips: But against bursty Assassins like Gusion, Karina, or Hirara, Popol and Kupa need to tread carefully. One misstep and they'll close in, putting an end to your hunt.
